## Problem

Describe the user request or agent failure this change addresses.

## Resulting behavior

Explain the observable behavior before and after the change, including cases where it should not apply.

## Evidence

List repository evidence, behavioral scenarios, or external sources used to justify the change.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_suite.py`
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] Relevant behavioral scenario added or run, when behavior changed
- [ ] Public documentation remains in English
- [ ] No unrelated skill or formatting changes
